power.greenlantern.batarang.desc: Throws a batarang where you aim. It cuts, slows the target for a moment, bounces off walls and comes back to the belt. Up to three in the air at once.
power.greenlantern.grapple.desc: Fires the hook up to 48 blocks. Once it bites into a block, the cable reels you in (high or far) and flings you over the ledge. Jump lets go mid-way. Hit a creature and it is pulled to you.
power.greenlantern.bat_swarm.desc: Calls a cloud of bats that circle you for 25 seconds, attack and blind your enemies and stop arrows and other projectiles. Use again to scatter them.
power.greenlantern.batmobile.desc: The Batmobile pulls up and you get in. W accelerates, S brakes and reverses, A and D steer, jump hops. Ctrl fires the jet boost, left-click launches missiles. Use again to get out and send the car away.

guide.greenlantern.batman.title: Batman
guide.greenlantern.batman:
The next hero of the DC Universe is §7Batman§r, the Dark Knight. He has no superpowers: he has training, an armored suit and a belt full of gadgets.

§6The belt§r
Craft the §6Utility Belt§r (leather, gold, iron and a phantom membrane). Right-click or press §eG§r to put on the suit: the cowl with its ears and night vision, the gray suit with the bat on the chest, the leggings and boots, and the long black cape. One hero at a time: putting on a suit takes the others off.

§6The Dark Knight§r
In the suit you are tougher, hit harder, move a little faster and see in the dark. Falls hurt much less.

§6Gliding with the cape§r
Falling from a height (more than two blocks above the ground), §ehold jump§r: the cape spreads like a wing. Look down to dive and pick up speed, look up to trade speed for height (out of speed, you lose lift). Turn by looking around, §eS§r brakes. Let go of jump to fold the cape. While gliding you never take fall damage.

§6Belt Charge§r
The gadgets use the Belt Charge (the bar of yellow cells). It recharges on its own, faster in the dark.
guide.greenlantern.batman_powers.title: Batman's Gadgets
guide.greenlantern.batman_powers:
In the suit, hold §eR§r for the gadget menu (tap R for the next one) and press §eV§r (or right-click with the belt) to use it.

§6Batarang§r
Throws a batarang where you aim. It cuts, slows the target, bounces off walls and comes back. Up to three in the air.

§6Grappling Hook§r
Fires the hook up to 48 blocks. Once it bites into a block, the cable reels you in, faster and faster, and flings you over the ledge: perfect for climbing buildings and cliffs. §eJump§r lets go mid-way (you keep the momentum, great to chain into a glide); §esneak§r lets go too. Hit a creature and the hook pulls it to you.

§6Bat Swarm§r
A cloud of 16 bats circles you for 25 seconds. They attack the monsters near you and whoever hurts you, blinding and slowing them, and throw themselves in front of arrows and other projectiles. Use again to scatter them.

§6Batmobile§r
The Batmobile pulls up and you get in the cockpit. §eW§r accelerates, §eS§r brakes and reverses, §eA D§r steer, §ejump§r hops. Hold §eCtrl (sprint)§r for the jet boost (uses charge). §eLeft-click§r fires two missiles that seek the target in your sights. Crashing into enemies at speed runs them over, and inside the car you take much less damage. §eSneak§r gets out; use the power again to get back in or to send the car back to the Batcave. Left parked alone for 3 minutes, it drives off.
guide.greenlantern.recipe.utility_belt: Leather in the corners, gold ingots on top and bottom, iron ingots on the sides and a phantom membrane in the center. The belt starts empty: put on the suit and wait for the cells to charge.
guide.greenlantern.controls_batman:
§eJump§r (hold, while falling): glide with the cape; look down to dive and up to climb.
§eR§r (hold / tap): gadget menu / next gadget.
§eV§r: uses the selected gadget. §eJump§r on the hook: let go of the cable.
§eIn the Batmobile§r: §eW A S D§r drive, §eCtrl§r boost, §eLeft-click§r missiles, §eSneak§r get out.
